keepAlive.label: Keep models loaded
keepAlive.description: How long a model stays in memory after its last use. Default follows the Ollama server (5 minutes unless OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE is set).

preload.label: Preload the chosen model
preload.description: Load the model selected in the chat as soon as you choose it and when ChatonLM starts, so your first message doesn't wait.

auto.label: Read responses aloud automatically
auto.description: Each new response is read aloud while it's being written, if the voice of its language is downloaded. Older responses aren't read when you open a chat.

voices.title: Voices
voices.description: One voice per language, downloaded once. Responses in other languages aren't read.

voiceMode.loadFailed: Couldn't read the voice mode settings: {message}

turns.label: Taking turns
turns.description: Hands-free: what you say is sent when you pause. Push to talk: hold Space, or the button of the voice bar, while you speak.

pause.label: Pause before sending
pause.description: How long you can stay silent before what you said is sent (hands-free). Choose Long if you're cut off mid-sentence.

bargeIn.label: Interrupt by speaking
bargeIn.description: Speaking over a reply stops it (hands-free). ChatonLM removes its own voice from what the microphone hears (echo cancellation), so this also works with speakers; headphones work best.

keepThink.label: Let models think
keepThink.description: Voice messages keep the choice of the Think button. Off: thinking is turned off when the model allows it, so replies start sooner.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.label: Voice instructions
instructions.description: Sent to the model with each voice message, never saved in the chat. Leave empty to use the default instructions shown in the field.

transcription.label: Speech recognition
transcription.description: Voice mode uses the speech model and the language of dictation.

voices.label: Voices
voices.description: Replies are read aloud with the voice of their language: English, French or Spanish.

global.title: Global shortcuts
global.description: They work in any app. You set their keys in your desktop, not in ChatonLM.
global.descriptionApp: They work in any app. Choose their keys here.

dictation.label: Dictation
dictation.off: Turn on dictation to use this shortcut.

proofread.label: Correct selected text
proofread.description: Corrects the text selected in any app.
proofread.off: Turn on the shortcut to choose its keys.

paste.label: Replace the selection
paste.description: ChatonLM pastes the corrected text over the selection. Turned off, the corrected text is only copied: press Ctrl+V to paste it.
paste.askHint: The first time, your desktop asks to let ChatonLM send the paste keystroke.
